# Fetch Jira issues linked from PRs

The module provides functionality to fetch Jira issues linked from Pull Requests using PR-linked issue keys. It supports fetching from both the live Jira Cloud REST API and from a pre-fetched JSON file cache, enabling use in both unattended CI environments and interactive compilations.

**Anchored to:**
